questions.question: Item 1 asks the reader to study Euclid’s construction, but the article does not provide the construction or a labelled diagram. Either add a verified explanation from a published source or rephrase the item.

localizations.source: Item 1 asks the reader to study Euclid’s construction, but the article does not provide the construction or a labelled diagram. Either add a verified explanation from a published source or rephrase the item.
localizations.ru: В пункте 1 читателю предлагается изучить способ решения Евклида, но статья не приводит саму конструкцию и её размеченный чертёж. Нужно либо добавить проверенное объяснение по опубликованному источнику, либо переформулировать пункт.

questions.question: Confirm a source attributing the inaccessible-vertex problem to Euclid, or identify it as a later variant: in Elements I.9 the vertex is accessible and used in the construction.

questions.question: The text closely reproduces Grigory Filippovsky’s chapter “Euclid and Problems with Inaccessible Points”, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation, translation, editing, and illustration work.
